title: Next Permutation
summary: Rearrange nums in place into the next lexicographically greater permutation; if none exists, rearrange into the lowest (ascending) permutation.
officialConstraints: 1 <= nums.length <= 100; 0 <= nums[i] <= 100 (from search snippet of official page; not independently verified).
visualizationNotes: Visualization accepts the official bounds (JSON array, 1 to 100 integers, 0 to 100). The solver does not cap further. Playback produces one snapshot per pointer or swap step.
